title: The Agony in the Garden: First Sorrowful Mystery
summary: Pray the First Sorrowful Mystery page by page: the story of the Agony in the Garden, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Carl Bloch's painting of the Agony in the Garden: an angel comforts Jesus as he prays.

pages.title: The Agony in the Garden
pages.body: In the garden of Gethsemane, Jesus prayed while his friends slept. His soul was sorrowful even to death, yet he said to the Father: not as I will, but as thou wilt. As we pray this decade, we bring our own fears to the Father and ask for the strength to say yes to him.
pages.alt: Carl Bloch's painting of the Agony in the Garden: an angel comforts Jesus as he prays.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 26 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“Then he saith to them: My soul is sorrowful even unto death: stay you here, and watch with me. And going a little further, he fell upon his face, praying, and saying: My Father, if it be possible, let this chalice pass from me. Nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.”

(Matthew 26:36-39)

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Agony in the Garden, the First Sorrowful Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Conformity to the Father's will
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of conformity to the Father's will. Jesus was afraid too, and he prayed. What worry can you hand to the Father tonight?

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, in every hard moment, help us say: not my will, but yours. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.
